speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with a breast mass; to help me determine the cause, have you noticed any changes in the size, shape, or color of the skin over the lump, or any changes to your nipple such as discharge or inversion?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rapidly growing breast mass in a 48-year-old female is highly suggestive of an invasive breast carcinoma, potentially inflammatory breast cancer or a high-grade angiosarcoma, given the rapid enlargement over 4 weeks. I will now order urgent imaging and pathology. REQUEST TEST: Mammography and Breast Ultrasound. REQUEST IMAGES: Left breast diagnostic mammogram and ultrasound. REQUEST TEST: Core needle biopsy with immunohistochemistry.
